(a) provided at the designated or sky lobby level for each single elevator or for each group of elevators.

(b) labeled "FIRE RECALL" and its positions marked "NORMAL" and "FIREMAN SERVICE" (in that order). The "FIRE RECALL" letters shall be a minimum of 5 mm (0.25 in.) high. Text shall be either red on a background that contrasts with red, or a color that contrasts with red on a red background.

(c) located in the lobby or sky lobby within sight of the elevator or all elevators in that group and shall be readily accessible.
